description.en: • Yuan Shaobau appears in "SD Gundam Sangokuden Brave Battle Warriors ". • Both sides of the cloak are movable. • Includes special weapon " Hikoken". • Reproduces the combination gimmick with Shin Yuanjutsu Zusa (sold separately). Molded product x 4, Seal x 1, instruction manual manga included
